inclusion_rule: Studies that report a recognition result on the DVS-Lip event-camera lip-reading dataset (100 isolated words, 40 speakers, speaker-disjoint 30/10 train/test split). Boundary: other event datasets (EventLRW, LIPSFUS, private recordings) are excluded unless DVS-Lip is also reported; versions of one study count once.
